headline: Penelope Keith, Effortlessly Posh Star of British Sitcoms, Dies at 86
context: A veteran stage actress, she starred in two of Britain’s most beloved TV comedies of the 1970s, “The Good Life” and “To the Manor Born.”

sources.name: The New York Times
